reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the 7.5% rounded tolerance instead of recomputing it.

duplication.why: The worst-case rule stays in one private helper (getPlannedAmount) behind getScheduledAmount; call sites only pass their own op field.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the ranged worst case already lived; callers in server and client just forward the operator.

scope.why: Focused on the rule, but it threads op through every caller including display cells and postTransactionForSchedule, so the approximate worst case also changes displayed and posted amounts, not only planning, without that choice being made explicit.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition, though inserting op positionally before the inverse boolean makes the signature (amount, op, inverse) easy to misuse and op is typed as a loose string.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount -> getPlannedAmount; every planning path (forecast normalizeSchedule, schedule-template, api-models expectedAmount, preview transactions, Balance) passes its op to it.
